rationale: Operator-authorized one-time structural fix, NOT a reflection cycle. evaluate_strategy() with direction=long can only return buy/hold, never sell, so the loop's exit branch was unreachable and every position could only close via stop_loss -- guaranteeing a 100% loss rate regardless of any variable tuned. Baseline was unlearnable: reflection would have blamed stop_loss_pct forever. Added a strategy-driven exit block (take-profit + RSI mean-reversion) so profitable exits are reachable and both conditions are tunable by future cycles.
